diagnosis.primary: DE extraction of residual tooth root (K08.301) treatment plan.

treatment_plan.notes: 1. You can eat and drink immediately after resin filling; 2. If you have sensitivity to hot and cold stimulation or pain when biting something after filling, you need to contact the attending doctor for follow-up treatment; 3. Children's dentistry is special, and children cry and are uncooperative. Sometimes, the filling may fall off, and the resin filling can be filled once for free within six months (except for loss caused by secondary caries or tooth trauma and fracture); 4. Remove the residual root in the mouth as soon as possible, and follow up for follow-up treatment if discomfort occurs.
